Name: Install Windows Service
Description: Install an executable as Windows Service

Properties.Description: How should the Windows Service be named (internal name)
Properties.Name: Service name

Properties.Description: How should the Windows Service be named when displayed to end users. If not specified the 'Service name' will be used.
Properties.Name: Display name (optional)

Properties.Description: Path to the folder where executable is located
Properties.Name: Installation directory

Properties.Description: Filename or path to the service main executable file. When specifying a path - it should be relative to 'Installation directory'.
Properties.Name: Executable name/path

Properties.Description: The service will be started using provided set of arguments on the command line.
Properties.Name: Executable arguments

Properties.Description: The service will run under this account type
Properties.Name: Account type

Properties.Description: Name of a specific Windows user account. Make sure this user has permission 'Log on as a service'.
Properties.Name: User account name

Properties.Description: Password for the specified Windows user account
Properties.Name: Password

Properties.Description: What should be the start mode, applied after a system reboot.
Properties.Name: Start mode

Properties.Description: What should be the initial service state after installation.
Properties.Name: State after installation
